purpose.summary: Bind the passive mainnet reproduction driver to the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0023 current-era v3 harness contract.
scope: Pin the technical target to signed commit 1b702c957e7f56cc69ab01add5c0f99fb1bc3f1f and tree d2a7a01007552e2f0e2600f2d57a5c318784260e, whose exact parent is c7246dfd9b37c6511495f14e765cf1b2443b5ed7 and tree 1bd307ee53a1ff37be66f0041e8b73b3c2c9c281.
Bind the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0023 record and passive-smoke runner bytes before either source is built or executed.
Validate only the v3 fixed-height-250000 report, including its immutable checkpoint, median time, joint-readiness observation, independent acquisition, restart, privacy and cleanup contracts.
Update the build-provenance receipt to schema v2 so its claims exactly reflect the changed v3 runtime semantics and exclusions.
Preserve closed failure-role diagnostics, suppressed raw child output, source authentication, dependency locking, binary revalidation and complete cleanup.
exclusions: No workflow, passive-smoke runtime harness, container, dependency-lock, production-node, consensus, validation-rule, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet or mainnet-parameter change.
No workflow dispatch, network run, incoming artifact, evidence promotion or claim that the rebound target has executed.
No v2 acceptance alias, backward fallback or acceptance of an unbound runner, record, parent, candidate, report or receipt contract.
No raw child output, peer address, absolute host path, parent environment, cookie, secret, port, datadir or runtime artifact enters generated evidence.

No current-tip, full-history, global-mainnet-coexistence, sustained-operation, peer-diversity, concurrent-peer-connection, concurrent-public-traffic, minimum-overlap-duration, deterministic-build or operator-binary claim.

limitations: This packet only rebinds tooling; it does not build, dispatch or execute the current-era passive-mainnet profile.
At most one future explicit workflow_dispatch is contemplated after signed publication; it is not authorized or performed by this record.
The v3 success contract reaches one fixed height-250000 checkpoint and does not cover current tip, full history or sustained operation.
A joint-readiness observation does not establish concurrent peer connections, concurrent public traffic, minimum overlap duration, peer diversity, distinct network paths or distinct hosts.
A closed failure diagnostic identifies a bounded role, disposition and reason code, not a node defect or root cause.
The mutable hosted runner image and operator binaries remain outside deterministic-build and operator-parity claims.
counterevidence: No public dispatch, incoming report, receipt or evidence artifact exists for this exact rebound target at record-review time.
The local ERGON-CHANGE-0023 same-binary mechanics smoke has no candidate source-to-binary build binding and cannot substitute for public reconstruction.
ERGON-CHANGE-0023 changed the harness to v3 but deliberately left the prior reproduction driver bound to v2.
Exact equality at one fixed checkpoint cannot establish current-tip agreement, complete historical replay, long-duration stability or global mainnet coexistence.
